title: Athasian Spell Compendium (Dark Sun, AD&D 2e)
description: Cleric and Wizard spell reference for the DARK SUN setting (AD&D 2nd Edition), parsed from the source PDFs by Depp-Magic. Athasian clerical magic is organized into the elemental spheres (Earth, Air, Fire, Water), the paraelemental sub-spheres (Magma, Rain, Silt, Sun), and the general Sphere of the Cosmos.
